summary: Safe Bulkers filed a Form 6-K reporting the sale of two drybulk vessels: MV Xenia (2006 Post-Panamax) for $13.0M and MV Pedhoulas Commander (2008 Kamsarmax) for $14.7M, totaling $27.7M. The company announced this as part of a fleet renewal strategy, citing recent investments in modern newbuilds and delivery of thirteen IMO GHG Phase 3 NOx Tier III vessels since 2022, with eleven additional newbuilds on order. Both vessels are to be delivered after their current voyages with dry-docking due. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The sales are asset divestitures, not a corporate sale. Watch for cash proceeds use and fleet age profile improvements.
